data.title: Could putting AI data centers in space solve an environmental problem, or create a new one?
data.description: Google is already testing AI computing in orbit, and SpaceX has plans for a massive satellite network. A Duke University researcher explains why the environmental benefits are far from guaranteed.
data.author: Liz McLaughlin, WRAL Climate Change Reporter
data.keywords: data center, outer space, artificial intelligence, Duke University, technology
